review_notes: I read all of PinnedSigns.lean and the definitions it depends on in BondPin.lean and BondSigns.lean. These were pinRestriction, bondPinRank, bondPinFactor, pinnedBondSubspace, pinnedBond_card, signFieldEquiv, compatibleSigns and compatibleSignsEquiv. The pinned set is {s compatible with η, s v = true on B}. Under signFieldEquiv, true maps to 0, so this set matches the kernel of the restriction to B inside the bond subspace. The cardinality formula is clusterWeight * bondPinFactor, and pinnedBond_card proves it with a consistent rank computation. The statements are not vacuous. The assumptions are consistent and the all-true sign vector always lies in the set, so it is never empty. The degenerate case B = ∅ gives bondPinFactor = 1 and recovers compatibleSigns_sum. Nothing in the file misstates its purpose. The only open point is that the file has no docstrings, so I could not compare the code against any documented intent. That is not an issue under this rubric.
